Also, I want to move my return flight from SFO back by one day. Could you help me with that? I prefer flights departing after 8am and before 9pm.
Sure, my user ID is yara_garcia_1905.

Thanks for the options. Before confirming, I want to mention that I have travel insurance, so I expect any change fees to be waived according to the policy I read on your website. Could you please confirm that there won't be any fees for these changes?

I understand, and I appreciate your clarification. Since there are no change fees and I will be refunded $186, I am ready to proceed. Please apply the refund to gift_card_6941833. Yes, please go ahead and make the changes.

Yes, actually. Now that the flights are changed, I'd like to upgrade my ticket to business class and add 2 checked bags for the outgoing flight. I'm willing to pay up to $200 for this upgrade and baggage. Could you check if that's possible?

$408 is more than I wanted to pay. I’m okay with keeping economy for the return flight if that helps reduce the upgrade cost. Can you check if upgrading just the outgoing flight to business and keeping the return in economy is possible within my $200 budget?

I see, thanks for explaining. I'll keep the reservation as it is in economy, but please add the 2 checked bags to my booking. I'm happy to pay for the bags using my original form of payment if there's any charge.
Yes, please go ahead and add the 2 checked bags to my reservation. Thank you! ###STOP###
